task_title: cut v0.1.5 so the published binaries stop shipping the vulnerable go1.26.5 toolchain
task_criteria: AC1 README pin line + both download URLs name v0.1.5 and make version-check exits 0. AC2 gh release view v0.1.5 shows 8 assets non-draft and releases/latest resolves v0.1.5. AC3 the DOWNLOADED v0.1.5 linux-amd64 asset reports go build info go1.26.6 (not go1.26.5) with vcs.revision == the v0.1.5 tag commit and vcs.modified=false, with the v0.1.4 go1.26.5 state as the before/after pair. AC4 sha256sum -c passes on the downloaded assets and the asset answers 'boardctl version v0.1.5'. AC5 0 unpushed and the remote tag resolves to the released commit. AC6 go build/vet/test -short/make fmt-check/make version-check/make vuln-check green and gofmt -l clean. AC7 no repo-root boardctl binary and .coding-hermes/board/* in no commit.
